tactics:
have hRS : R = S := by funext a b; exact propext (h a b)
  subst hRS
  rfl

induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => simp [List.pairwise_cons, ih, h]
have hRS : R = S := funext fun a => funext fun b => propext (h a b)
constructor <;> intro hp <;> [exact hp.imp (fun hab => (h _ _).mp hab); exact hp.imp (fun hab => (h _ _).mpr hab)]
simp only [show R = S from funext fun a => funext fun b => propext (h a b)]
